title: Frustum tub geometry (open box wider at the top)
summary: A tapered open box as its own BufferGeometry with metric UVs: mine-cart tubs, hoppers, bins, planters. Avoids the sheared 'diamond' of a rotated-then-scaled 4-sided cylinder.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: const tub = new THREE.Mesh(frustum(1.5, .95, 1.15, .65, .6), std(0x8a7a6e, .7, { side: THREE.DoubleSide }));   // top L W, bottom L W, height

doc.when: Any open container with sloped sides.
doc.avoid: CylinderGeometry(r0, r1, h, 4) + rotation pi/4 + non-uniform scale: scale applies before rotation, so it shears.
gotchas: Faces are single-sided: use DoubleSide to see inside.
o.floor (default true) closes the bottom, o.lid closes the top.

params.frustum(tl, tw, bl, bw, h, o): origin at the bottom centre; o.unit metres per UV
